definitions.gloss: selective breeding; breed improvement; cultivar development
definitions.explanation: The process of selectively breeding plants or animals to develop desired traits such as disease resistance, higher yield, better flavor, or improved appearance.

examples.japanese: {品種改良|ひんしゅかいりょう}で{甘|あま}いイチゴが{生|う}まれた。
examples.english: Sweet strawberries were created through selective breeding.

examples.japanese: {品種改良|ひんしゅかいりょう}には{長|なが}い{年月|ねんげつ}がかかる。
{日本|にほん}の{米|こめ}は{品種改良|ひんしゅかいりょう}を{重|かさ}ねて、{味|あじ}も{収穫量|しゅうかくりょう}も{大幅|おおはば}に{向上|こうじょう}した。
examples.english: Through repeated selective breeding, Japanese rice has greatly improved in both flavor and yield.

notes:
A compound of {品種|ひんしゅ} (breed, variety, cultivar) and {改良|かいりょう} (improvement). Used for both plant cultivation and animal breeding, this term covers traditional selective breeding methods as well as modern biotechnological approaches.

USAGE:
Frequently appears in discussions about agriculture, horticulture, animal husbandry, and food science. Japan has a long tradition of {品種改良|ひんしゅかいりょう}, particularly for rice, fruits, and ornamental plants. Used as a noun or with する.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {品種改良|ひんしゅかいりょう}を{行|おこな}う — to carry out selective breeding
- {品種改良|ひんしゅかいりょう}を{重|かさ}ねる — to repeat selective breeding over generations
- {品種改良|ひんしゅかいりょう}された{品種|ひんしゅ} — an improved variety

RELATED WORDS:
- {品種|ひんしゅ} — breed, variety, cultivar; the type of plant or animal
- {遺伝子組|いでんしく}み{換|か}え — genetic modification; a more controversial modern alternative
- {交配|こうはい} — crossbreeding; one of the main techniques used in selective breeding
